theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 19 群

items.pos: v. 分開；分配 | n. 分歧
items.colloc: divide into 分成 | divide equally 平均分配
items.distinct: distribute 分發；配送 | separate 分隔
ex: The manager will divide the team into two groups.
經理將把團隊分成兩組。
We need to divide the budget among departments.
我們需要將預算分配給各部門。
This policy divides opinions within the company.
這項政策在公司內部引發了意見分歧。

items.pos: v. 交換；兌換 | n. 交換；交易所
items.colloc: exchange rate 匯率 | in exchange for 以...作為交換
items.distinct: replace 取代 | substitute 代替
ex: I would like to exchange these dollars for euros.
我想把這些美元兌換成歐元。
The two companies decided to exchange technical expertise.
兩家公司決定交換技術專業知識。
She received a gift in exchange for her help.
她因為幫忙而收到了一份禮物。

items.pos: v. 借出；提供（幫助、權威）
items.colloc: lend money 借錢 | lend support 提供支持
items.distinct: borrow 借入 | rent 租借
ex: Could you lend me your laptop for the meeting?
會議時你可以借我筆電嗎？
The bank refused to lend funds to the startup.
銀行拒絕提供資金給這家新創公司。
Her presence lends credibility to the new project.
她的出席為這個新專案提供了可信度。

items.colloc: leading manufacturer 主要製造商 | local manufacturer 當地製造商
items.distinct: retailer 零售商 | wholesaler 批發商
ex: They are the largest manufacturer of electronic parts.
他們是最大的電子零件製造商。
Please contact the manufacturer regarding the product defect.
請針對產品瑕疵聯繫製造商。
The manufacturer offers a full warranty for buyers.
該製造商為買家提供全面保固。

items.colloc: as soon as possible 盡快 | make it possible 使...成為可能
items.distinct: potential 潛在的 | probable 很可能的
ex: Please finish the report as soon as possible.
請盡快完成那份報告。
We need to explore all possible solutions today.
我們今天需要探討所有可能的解決方案。
New technology makes remote work possible for us.
新技術使我們能夠進行遠距工作。

items.colloc: power outage 停電 | negotiating power 談判權
items.distinct: force 武力；力量 | energy 能源；精力
ex: The power went out during the afternoon conference.
下午會議期間停電了。
She has the power to sign off on contracts.
她有權力簽署合約。
This machine requires a lot of power to run.
這台機器運作需要大量電力。

items.colloc: prefer A to B 喜歡A勝過B | would prefer 想要
items.distinct: favor 偏愛 | choose 選擇
ex: Many employees prefer to work from home today.
許多員工今天偏好在家工作。
Do you prefer a digital or a paper copy?
你偏好數位版還是紙本？
I would prefer to review the document later.
我比較想晚點再審閱文件。

items.colloc: rapid growth 快速成長 | rapid change 快速變動
items.distinct: quick 迅速的（短時間） | swift 敏捷的；迅速的
ex: The company saw rapid growth in the last quarter.
公司在上一季經歷了快速成長。
We must react to the rapid market changes.
我們必須對快速的市場變化做出反應。
Rapid progress was made on the construction site.
工地取得了快速的進展。

items.colloc: react to 對...做出反應 | react negatively 反應負面
items.distinct: respond 回覆；應答 | reply 回答
ex: Investors did not react well to the news.
投資人對這項消息反應不佳。
It is important to react quickly to complaints.
對客訴做出快速回應很重要。
How did the board react to your proposal?
董事會對你的提案有何反應？

items.colloc: recent survey 最近的調查 | recent development 近期發展
items.distinct: late 遲的；晚的 | latest 最新的
ex: Please review the recent financial reports carefully.
請仔細審閱近期的財務報告。
This is based on a recent market study.
這是基於一項最近的市場研究。
There have been many recent changes in policy.
政策近期有了許多變動。

items.pos: v. 視為；尊重 | n. 關注；尊敬
items.colloc: regard as 視為 | in regard to 關於
items.distinct: respect 尊敬 | consider 考慮
ex: We regard quality as our top priority here.
我們將品質視為這裡的首要任務。
Please call me in regard to the new contract.
請就新合約相關事宜打電話給我。
He is highly regarded by all his colleagues.
他受到所有同事的高度敬重。

items.colloc: remarkable achievement 非凡成就 | remarkable progress 顯著進步
items.distinct: noticeable 明顯的 | exceptional 例外的；傑出的
ex: The team made remarkable progress this month.
團隊本月取得了顯著進展。
It was a remarkable achievement for the company.
這對公司而言是一項非凡的成就。
She showed a remarkable ability to solve problems.
她展現了解決問題的非凡能力。

items.colloc: remove from 從...移除 | remove obstacles 排除障礙
items.distinct: delete 刪除 | eliminate 淘汰；根除
ex: We need to remove the outdated software programs.
我們需要移除過時的軟體程式。
The technician will remove the broken part today.
技術人員今天會移除損壞的零件。
She managed to remove all barriers to entry.
她成功消除了所有的進入門檻。

items.colloc: typically occur 通常發生 | typically involve 通常涉及
items.distinct: usually 通常 | normally 正常地
ex: Our meetings typically start at nine o'clock.
我們的會議通常在九點開始。
This error typically occurs during system updates.
這個錯誤通常發生在系統更新期間。
Such projects typically require a large budget.
這類專案通常需要大筆預算。

items.colloc: a variety of 各式各樣的 | wide variety 各種各樣
items.distinct: diversity 多樣性 | range 範圍
ex: The store offers a wide variety of office supplies.
這家店提供各式各樣的辦公用品。
We have a variety of options to choose from.
我們有各種各樣的選擇可以挑選。
The task requires a variety of different skills.
這項工作需要各種不同的技能。

items.colloc: dramatic increase 劇增 | dramatic change 戲劇性變化
items.distinct: drastic 激烈的；猛烈的 | dynamic 動態的
ex: Sales saw a dramatic increase after the ad.
廣告播出後銷售額顯著增加。
There was a dramatic change in market demand.
市場需求發生了戲劇性的變化。
The new policy had a dramatic impact today.
新政策今天產生了巨大的影響。

items.pos: n. 市場 | v. 行銷
items.colloc: market share 市佔率 | market research 市場研究
items.distinct: supermarket 超級市場 | mall 購物中心
ex: We are trying to expand into the global market.
我們正試圖擴展到全球市場。
The team will market the new product online.
團隊將在網路上行銷這項新產品。
Market research shows customers want better quality.
市場研究顯示客戶想要更好的品質。

items.pos: n. 事件；問題 | v. 要緊；有關係
items.colloc: as a matter of fact 事實上 | important matter 重要事務
items.distinct: issue 議題；爭議 | subject 主題
ex: It is a private matter between the partners.
這是合夥人之間的私事。
Does it matter if the report is late?
報告遲交有關係嗎？
They discussed several urgent matters this morning.
他們今天早上討論了幾件緊急事務。

items.pos: v. 轉移；調職 | n. 轉移
items.colloc: transfer to 調職到 | bank transfer 銀行轉帳
items.distinct: transport 運輸 | shift 轉移；移動
ex: He requested a transfer to the branch office.
他申請調職到分公司。
Please transfer the funds to our savings account.
請將資金轉入我們的儲蓄帳戶。
The company will transfer the project files soon.
公司很快會轉移專案檔案。

items.colloc: accounting department 會計部門 | accounting firm 會計師事務所
items.distinct: account 帳戶 | accountant 會計師
ex: She works in the accounting department at headquarters.
她在總公司的會計部門工作。
The accounting records must be kept up to date.
會計紀錄必須保持更新。
He is studying accounting at the local university.
他正在當地大學研讀會計學。
